thread:
Devon Park: quick ask — noticing ~20-30% higher p50 for batch=8 on L40S vs H100 for our chat seq=1024 workload after the kernel change (commit abc7d3). Can someone run two quick micro-benchmarks (same model & quant, different SKUs) and paste numbers? Want p50/p95 and tokens/sec.
Maya Chen: I can run on H100. which model & config?
Devon Park: use gptx-7b-quant, seq=1024, prompt warm=1, batch sizes [1,8,16], kv cache enabled. --run-duration 60s. prefix caching off.
Liam O'Neill: tagging @Aj — Aj, can you do L40S? I'm on holidays but can kick off a1.
Aj Singh: can do L40S later today. do you have the exact bench command?
Devon Park: paste:
```
./bench --model gptx-7b-quant --seq_len 1024 --batch 8 --kv_cache on --quant q4_0 --duration 60 --metrics p50,p95,tokens_per_sec
```
Devon Park: also include kernel branch `runtime/opt-kernel-2026-03` in env var KERNEL_SHA=abc7d3
perf-bot: Scheduled benchmark on h100-cluster-2 for 60s. Job id: pb-88231. Results will post here when done.
Maya Chen: H100 run done, batch 8 => p50 72ms, p95 130ms, tokens/sec 4800. attaching short log.
Maya Chen: (log snippet) ```p50=72ms p95=130ms tps=4800```
perf-bot: L40S run queued on l40s-pool-1. ETA ~45m.
Aj Singh: started L40S run, job id pb-88255. I'll post when finished. Also will try batch=16 to see trend.
Liam O'Neill: thanks, Dev. If L40S shows regression we should bisect kernel change — might be conv kernel fallback.
Devon Park: agree. if Aj's numbers show >20% gap, I'll open an RFC and assign a bisect.
Aj Singh: L40S results: batch8 p50 92ms p95 185ms tokens/sec 3900. batch16 p50 145ms p95 320ms tps 2100.
Maya Chen: ugh that's ~28% worse on p50 and tps. :thinking_face:
Devon Park: okay that's actionable. Aj — can you capture perf counters (L2 miss, SM occupancy) next run with `--perf-counters`? Also capture nvprof trace if possible.
Aj Singh: on it. rerunning with counters now.
perf-bot: Result pb-88255: uploaded artifacts to s3://redwood-perf/pb-88255/.
Devon Park: thanks all. I'll file the bisect ticket and tag runtime/eng. tagging @Liam O'Neill for kernel assist. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Neill: I'll look tomorrow. if it's a kernel fallback we can revert or add a SKU-specific path.
Aj Singh: posted counters — l2_miss=12.3% sm_occ=78% ... full JSON in S3 link.
Devon Park: sweet. closing the loop once bisect starts. appreciate the quick runs.
